rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for an adult person, especially in contrast with a child.

example.english: An adult can come in here, but children should go next door.
example.traditional: 呢度只招待大人，細路唔該去隔籬。
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 zi2 ziu1 doi6 daai6 jan4 sai3 lou6 m4 goi1 heoi3 gaak3 lei4

rows.note: Use this when explicitly referring to a person who has reached adulthood or legal majority.

example.english: A person who is eighteen or over counts as an adult.
example.traditional: 年滿十八歲先算成年人。
example.jyutping: nin4 mun5 sap6 baat3 seoi3 sin1 syun3 sing4 nin4 jan4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that is fully grown or physically mature.

example.english: This is an adult tree now.
example.jyutping: ni1 fo2 syu6 ji5 ging1 sing4 suk6 laa3

rows.note: Use this for material designed or aimed at adults rather than children.

example.english: This film is adult-oriented and not suitable for children.
example.traditional: 呢套電影係成人向，唔啱細路睇。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 din6 jing2 hai6 sing4 jan4 hoeng3 m4 ngaam1 sai3 lou6 tai2

rows.note: Use this specifically when “adult” means sexually explicit or pornographic.

example.english: This magazine contains adult content, so anyone under eighteen should not read it.
example.traditional: 呢本雜誌有色情內容，未夠十八歲唔好睇。
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 zaap6 zi3 jau5 sik1 cing4 noi6 jung4 mei6 gau3 sap6 baat3 seoi3 m4 hou2 tai2

rows.note: Use this technical biological term for a fully grown animal or other organism rather than a juvenile.

example.english: This fish is considered fully developed only when it reaches the adult stage.
example.traditional: 呢隻魚去到成體先至算完全發育。
example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 jyu4 heoi3 dou3 sing4 tai2 sin1 zi3 syun3 jyun4 cyun4 faat3 juk6

rows.note: Use this on things such as menus or fares intended specifically for older children.

example.english: This menu has an adult option for older children, not little kids.
example.traditional: 呢張餐牌有大童專用餐，唔係畀細路仔㗎。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 caan1 paai4 jau5 daai6 tung4 zyun1 jung6 caan1 m4 hai6 bei2 sai3 lou6 zai2 gaa3
